insight: Founded in 2019 by ex-AWS SageMaker principal engineer Leo Dirac; named to CB Insights' AI 100 in 2024.
name: Groundlight
tagline: Build reliable computer vision by asking plain-English questions about images.
description: Groundlight lets developers create visual detectors by describing what to look for in natural language, with no training dataset required. Its system pairs ML models with built-in 24/7 human labeling, so applications return reliable answers from day one and the models improve automatically over time. It ships a Python SDK and REST API, supports edge inference on hardware like Raspberry Pi, and powers monitoring, industrial inspection, and robotics use cases.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own vision models with built-in human-in-the-loop labeling; no dataset required.

edge: Define a vision detector by asking a plain-English question; built-in 24/7 human labeling means it answers from day one with no training data.
